title: Synthetic Micro-Irrigation Support Test Policy
raw_content: SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT — NOT A REAL GOVERNMENT SCHEME. Section 1. The fictional support is available in Gujarat for agricultural micro-irrigation activity. Section 2. A fictional applicant must report no more than 2 hectares of agricultural land. Section 3. The fictional benefit is a mock equipment voucher. This document contains no farmer names, phone numbers, addresses, account identifiers, or other personal data.
